lifespan.note: Banco de la República gives birth on 25 April 1566 and death toward 1642; other Banco de la República scholarship uses 1638. End year remains unresolved in v0.1.

active_period.note: Relevant writing horizon for El Carnero in Banrepcultural's description.

uncertainty: Freyle was not a direct witness of the pre-contact Guatavita offering activity modeled in LEGEND.
His statement that don Juan was his informant is source evidence for a claimed transmission chain; don Juan is not yet canonicalized as a separate SUPERHERO person.
Being an early surviving recorder of a version does not establish that Freyle invented or originated the tradition.
Biographical references differ on Freyle's death year.

review.note: Canonical scope is historical identity and documented recorder/compiler role in the Guatavita/El Dorado transmission chain.
